message: No detected untrusted source handling: No remote data fetching is visible in the code; DATASET_DIR is set to None in config.py with no checksum verification, signed URLs, or authenticated source handling anywhere in the shown code.

No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense present in the code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanism is imported or used anywhere in the code.
